mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.transfer_id, i.sku_id, i.quantity, i.unit_snapshot, i.remark, k.sku_code, k.spec_name AS sku_name, k.spec_values, p.name AS product_name FROM inventory_transfer_item i LEFT JOIN product_sku k ON k.id = i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = k.spu_id WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND i.transfer_id = #{transferId} ORDER BY i.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_transfer_item SET deleted = TRUE, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE transfer_id = #{transferId} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE inventory_transfer_item SET unit_snapshot = #{unit}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
